claims.head: The matchup inside the matchup
claims.body: The Golden Knights are one of the league’s best for chance quality, and the Kraken are one of the league’s best at preventing dangerous shots. We’ll side with the Golden Knights.
claims.call: The Golden Knights’ chances are more dangerous than the league average (a 6.3% chance of scoring on the average shot) against the Kraken.
claims.nums: Vegas 5th for chance quality (a 6.7% chance of scoring on the average shot) · Seattle 2nd for preventing dangerous shots
claims.gist: It’s strength against strength: the Golden Knights for chance quality, the Kraken at preventing dangerous shots.

claims.head: The Kraken can’t afford to take penalties
claims.call: The Golden Knights’ power play creates at least their usual 8.9 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Golden Knights’ power play is one of the league’s best, and the Kraken’s kill is near the bottom of the league. The Kraken need to stay out of the box.
claims.nums: Vegas 2nd for power play (8.9 expected goals per 60) · Seattle 27th for penalty kill
claims.gist: The Golden Knights’ power play has a soft target in the Kraken’s kill.

claims.head: The Golden Knights are going to test the Kraken’s goalie early and often
claims.call: The Golden Knights take at least their usual 59.2 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5.
claims.body: Seattle has been giving up shots all season, and the Golden Knights rarely pass one up.
claims.nums: Vegas 9th for shot volume (59.2 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5) · Seattle 32nd for shot suppression
claims.gist: The Golden Knights shoot a lot, and the Kraken give up plenty.

SEA.head: Everything points away from Seattle
SEA.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and Seattle has home ice. Seattle could still pull it off if they keep dangerous shots away, but they might need a miracle.

VGK.head: A big edge for Vegas
VGK.body: Vegas has controlled the play far better over recent games and Seattle has home ice. Anything short of a win would be a surprise, though Seattle can make a game of it if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: Eichel’s favourite opponent
paras: The Golden Knights already came to Seattle once this season and left with a 6-2 win. The Kraken are 2-2-0. The Golden Knights have won two in a row, the last a 6-2 rout of Seattle.
It’s strength against strength: the Golden Knights for chance quality, the Kraken at preventing dangerous shots. The Golden Knights’ power play has a soft target in the Kraken’s kill.
